reason: Checked every leg against fresh news since the 2026-09-16 FOMC hike (25bp to 3.75-4.00%) and found no thesis-breaking developments, only confirmations. GOOGL's ad-tech antitrust overhang resolved favorably (behavioral remedies, not a breakup) while revenue/net income both grew >20% YoY and 62 analysts hold Strong Buy at 17.5x earnings - the cheapest mega-cap in the book got materially de-risked, not weaker. AVGO's CEO explicitly reaffirmed AI infrastructure demand ('targets haven't changed') and the stock rallied +2.97% on 9/18 after the drawdown that shows in this leg's -15.3% mark, consistent with a volatility shakeout rather than a broken moat. UNH has two concrete positive catalysts in the last three weeks (WellMed stake sale to TPG, prior-auth rollback starting Oct 1) and sits far below its $481.72 average target. LLY's pipeline news flow (Inluriyo approval, >30% share of new oral GLP-1 starts, AtaiBeckley deal) keeps the compounding thesis intact despite the mark-to-market drawdown. V/MA are already green and unaffected by the hike's transmission mechanism, which hits floating-rate/small-cap balance sheets, not payments networks. That is exactly why the IWM short stays on: small caps are near 52-week highs on YTD outperformance that one source flagged as riding on deteriorating forward earnings estimates, and a hike that raises funding costs for the most debt-levered, least-profitable index constituents is a tailwind for this leg, which is already +5.05%. With no leg's fundamental case broken, a full replacement would only pay 2-12bps per side x9 legs of pure churn on a book that is already +2.75% net since inception versus SPY's +1.71% - the discipline is to let a working, News-confirmed quality-compounder book keep compounding, not to trade around a Fed decision the market had already priced in and digested calmly (SPX -0.54% over the past month, +0.17% on the day after the hike).
